sentences.en: There is no doubt that President Donald Trump has had an electrifying effect on NATO.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，唐纳德·特朗普总统对北约产生了令人震撼的影响。

sentences.en: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization was founded after World War II, primarily to act as a kind of bulwark against the then-Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 北大西洋公约组织成立于二战之后，主要是为了充当一种抵御当时苏联的屏障。

sentences.en: Its 32 member nations, which include most of Europe, Canada, Turkey, and the U.S., are bound by this Pledge of Common Defense.
sentences.zh: 其32个成员国（包括欧洲大部分地区、加拿大、土耳其和美国）都受这项共同防御誓言的约束。

sentences.en: The alliance's most famous provision, known as Article 5, states that an attack on one member country would require the response of all.
sentences.zh: 该联盟最著名的条款被称为第五条，规定对一个成员国的攻击将需要所有成员国的回应。

sentences.en: In practice, though, the United States is NATO's most important member.
sentences.zh: 但在实践中，美国却是北约最重要的成员。

sentences.en: It provides the troops, intelligence, logistics and nuclear arsenal that make the alliance work.
sentences.zh: 它提供了使该联盟得以运转的军队、情报、后勤和核武库。

sentences.en: President Trump has excoriated NATO as a financial drain on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统严厉抨击北约是美国的一个财政累赘，

sentences.en: and has several times even threatened to withdraw from it.
sentences.zh: 甚至曾数次威胁要退出北约。

sentences.en: Mark Rutte is the man who's been tasked with keeping Trump happy while setting up NATO for this new, more dangerous era, where Russia has expansionist ambitions, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 马克·吕特就是那个被委以重任的人：他既要让特朗普高兴，又要让北约做好准备，迎接这个充满危险的新时代——在这个时代里，俄罗斯有着扩张主义的野心，美国

sentences.en: is seen as more unreliable, and Europe is woefully underprepared to fight its own battles.
sentences.zh: 被认为更加不可靠，而欧洲在打自己的仗方面却极其准备不足。

sentences.en: He became NATO Secretary General late last year after 14 years as Prime Minister of the Netherlands, where his longevity as a right-of-center leader
sentences.zh: 他在担任荷兰首相14年后，于去年年底出任北约秘书长；他在中右翼领导人岗位上的长寿，

sentences.en: earned him the nickname Teflon Mark.
sentences.zh: 为他赢得了“特氟龙马克”的绰号。

sentences.en: I met Ruta earlier this week at NATO headquarters in Brussels after a pivotal summit where member states pledged to drastically increase their defense spending.
sentences.zh: 本周早些时候，我在布鲁塞尔的北约总部见到了吕特，此前刚结束一场关键的峰会，各成员国在会上承诺大幅增加国防开支。

sentences.en: But the biggest headlines out of the summit were actually about Ruta's relationship with Trump.
sentences.zh: 但峰会传出的最大新闻实际上是关于吕特与特朗普的关系。

sentences.en: Ruta joked that Trump had acted as a daddy to misbehaving Middle Eastern nations, a nickname the president clearly loved.

sentences.en: His fundraising committee even started selling daddy T-shirts.

sentences.en: For some observers, it was evidence that Rutte is willing to do whatever it takes to keep Trump happy and the NATO alliance healthy, even as the U.S.

sentences.en: Secretary General, thank you so much for joining the interview.
sentences.zh: 秘书长，非常感谢您接受采访。

sentences.en: I really appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 我非常感激您抽出时间。

sentences.en: Really appreciate being here.
sentences.zh: 非常高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you for the invitation.
sentences.zh: 感谢您的邀请。

sentences.en: I'm going to start with a big but basic question.
sentences.zh: 我从一个重大但基础的问题开始。

sentences.en: And I want it to be in the form of an elevator pitch, if you will.
sentences.zh: 而且我希望它能以电梯演讲的形式呈现，如果您愿意的话。

sentences.en: Why should NATO matter to Americans now?
sentences.zh: 为什么美国人现在还应该重视北约？

sentences.en: What do Americans get out of this treaty today?
sentences.zh: 美国人今天从这个条约中得到了什么？

sentences.en: It should matter.
sentences.zh: 它应该受到重视。

sentences.en: And if I was in the elevator, I would say, if you want to defend the US, you have to make sure that three things are secure.
sentences.zh: 如果我在电梯里，我会说，如果你想保卫美国，你必须确保三件事是安全的。

sentences.en: You need a secure Arctic because it is opening up and the Chinese and the Russians are sailing there.
sentences.zh: 你需要一个安全的北极，因为它正在融化开放，中国人和俄罗斯人正在那里航行。

sentences.en: You need a secure Atlantic because it is your sea, it is crucial.
sentences.zh: 你需要一个安全的大西洋，因为它是你们的海洋，这至关重要。

sentences.en: And you need a secure Europe because Russia is here.
sentences.zh: 你需要一个安全的欧洲，因为俄罗斯就在这里。

sentences.en: And And Russia is reconstituting itself at an incredible pace and not to attack Norway, but to attack ultimately the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且俄罗斯正在以惊人的速度重整军备，不是为了进攻挪威，而是为了最终进攻美国。

sentences.en: So if the Arctic, if the Atlantic Ocean, if Europe is not secure, U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果北极、大西洋、欧洲不安全，美国

sentences.en: has a big problem.
sentences.zh: 就会有大麻烦。

sentences.en: I'm assuming that's how you sold it to President Trump, who has conspicuously not been a very big fan of NATO and essentially views Europe, as he has mentioned in the past,
sentences.zh: 我假设你就是这样向特朗普总统推销这一点的，他显然一直不是北约的超级粉丝，并且基本上将欧洲视为——正如他过去曾提到过的——

sentences.en: as a bunch of freeloaders.
sentences.zh: 一群白吃白喝的人。

sentences.en: He sees it as European nations basically funding their welfare states, giving free health care, giving pensions at the expense of American defense.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，欧洲国家基本上是在用美国国防的代价来资助他们的福利国家、提供免费医疗和养老金。

sentences.en: You think that view is fair?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这种看法公平吗？

sentences.en: The second half of the view is fair.
sentences.zh: 这种看法的后半部分是公平的。

sentences.en: But the first half, I would not buy into, because I think that, and I'm pretty much confident of the fact that the American president, Trump, very much realizes,
sentences.zh: 但前半部分我无法认同，因为我认为——而且我非常确信——美国总统特朗普深知，

sentences.en: and his whole team, based on my conversations when I was in Washington in March, when I was in April, when I had conversations last week in The Hague, that for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他的整个团队也是如此（根据我在3月访问华盛顿、4月访问华盛顿以及上周在海牙进行交谈时的了解），为了让美国

sentences.en: to stay strong and safe, there is this embeddedness with European security.
sentences.zh: 保持强大和安全，欧洲安全与美国是密不可分的。

sentences.en: and, of course, working together to keep the inner Pacific safe.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有共同努力以维护印太地区的安全。

sentences.en: But I do agree with the second half because there is this enormous irritant since Eisenhower with American presidents, and I think they're completely right
sentences.zh: 但我确实同意后半部分，因为自从艾森豪威尔以来，美国总统们一直存在一种巨大的痛点，而且我认为他们完全正确，

sentences.en: that the Europeans were not paying enough and that you are paying on average 3.5% of your GDP on defense that the Europeans were, well, struggling to get to 2%.
sentences.zh: 即欧洲人过去没有支付足够的费用，你们将GDP的平均3.5%用于国防，而欧洲人当时却在艰难地达到2%的目标。

sentences.en: So there, he has a big point, and luckily, last week in The Hague, we solved that.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上，他说得很对，幸运的是，上周在海牙，我们解决了这个问题。

sentences.en: Before we get into that substance, I'd like to talk a little bit about the style, because your interactions with President Trump in the aftermath of that meeting
sentences.zh: 在我们讨论具体内容之前，我想先谈谈行事风格，因为在那次会议之后你与特朗普总统的互动

sentences.en: have been called, and I'm quoting here, fawning and orchestrated grovel.
sentences.zh: 被称作——我在这里引用原话——“奴颜婢膝”和“精心排演的卑躬屈膝”。

sentences.en: I saw someone refer to NATO now as the North Atlantic Trump Organization.
sentences.zh: 我看到有人现在把北约叫做“北大西洋特朗普组织”。

sentences.en: It's been a week of a lot of criticism.
sentences.zh: 这是充满大量批评的一周。

sentences.en: How do you see it?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么看待这一点的？

sentences.en: Well, let's face what is happening.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们正视正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: There were seven or eight countries in Europe, not at 2%.
sentences.zh: 欧洲有七八个国家的国防开支没有达到2%。

sentences.en: So now it's 5%, a new benchmark.
sentences.zh: 所以现在是5%，这是一个新的基准。

sentences.en: Do we really think that we would have been able last week in The Hague to agree to that 5% if Trump would not have been re-elected as president of the United States?
sentences.zh: 我们真的认为，如果特朗普没有当选美国总统，我们上周在海牙能够达成这5%的协议吗？

sentences.en: So I think when somebody deserves praise, that praise should be given.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，当一个人值得称赞时，就应该给予称赞。

sentences.en: And President Trump deserves all the praise because without his leadership, without him being re-elected as president of the United States,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统值得所有的赞誉，因为如果没有他的领导，没有他再次当选美国总统，

sentences.en: the 2% this year and the 5% in 2035, we would never, ever, ever have been able to achieve agreement on this.
sentences.zh: 今年的2%和2035年的5%的目标，我们绝对、绝对、绝对不可能达成一致。

sentences.en: I want to get to what exactly these numbers are and what they mean, but there are these two camps after this summit.
sentences.zh: 我想探讨一下这些数字到底是什么以及它们意味着什么，但这次峰会之后出现了两个阵营。

sentences.en: You know, one said that you did what you did to sort of pacify President Trump's ego and have a successful summit, which you did.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一个阵营说你这么做是为了平息特朗普总统的自尊心并举办一场成功的峰会，而你也确实做到了。

sentences.en: And the other says that while our president likes flattery, he ultimately sees it as weakness, and it only appeases him for so long.
sentences.zh: 另一个阵营则说，虽然我们的总统喜欢奉承，但他最终认为这是软弱的表现，这只能暂时安抚他。

sentences.en: I'm sure you've seen all this commentary afterwards.
sentences.zh: 我确信你已经看到了所有这些后续评论。

sentences.en: I was 14 years prime minister of the Netherlands, so I know about criticism, but I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我曾担任荷兰首相14年，所以我对批评习以为常，但我不在乎。

sentences.en: In the end, I need to do my job.
sentences.zh: 到头来，我必须做好我的工作。

sentences.en: I have to keep the whole of NATO together.
sentences.zh: 我必须把整个北约凝聚在一起。

sentences.en: And the biggest ally is the United States.
sentences.zh: 而最大的盟友就是美国。

sentences.en: That biggest ally has paid since Eisenhower more than the Europeans.
sentences.zh: 自艾森豪威尔以来，这个最大的盟友付出的比欧洲人更多。

sentences.en: And now for the first time in 65 years, we will equalize between what the US is paying and what the Europeans are paying.
sentences.zh: 现在，在65年里第一次，我们将实现美国出资与欧洲出资的平衡。

sentences.en: And without Trump, that would not have happened.
sentences.zh: 如果没有特朗普，这是不可能发生的。

sentences.en: Did you mind the text message that you sent him being made public by him?
sentences.zh: 你介意你发给他的短信被他公之于众吗？

sentences.en: Not at all, because what was in the text message is exactly as I see it.
sentences.zh: 一点也不介意，因为短信里的内容正是我所看到的。

sentences.en: One, that he did an excellent job on Iran with the bombing of the nuclear facility.
sentences.zh: 第一，他在轰炸核设施事件上对伊朗的处理非常出色。

sentences.en: And as I said in that text message, you are now flying into another big success, which is a NATO summit, which will commit to 5% defense spending.
sentences.zh: 正如我在那条短信中所说，你现在正飞向另一个巨大的成功，那就是北约峰会，它将承诺把国防开支提高到5%。

sentences.en: And this is transformational.
sentences.zh: 这是具有变革意义的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: we are meeting after this NATO summit and the big success is that the member nations except for Spain agreed to increase their defense spending to 5% of their GDP by 2035.
sentences.zh: 我们在这次北约峰会后举行会晤，而最大的成功在于，除西班牙外，成员国一致同意在2035年前将国防开支提高到其GDP的5%。

sentences.en: Can you briefly talk me through why 5% is the right number?
sentences.zh: 你能简要向我说明为什么5%是正确的数字吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, by the way, all 32 agreed.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，所有32个国家都同意了。

sentences.en: There's one issue with Spain and that is Spain is saying, okay, we agree, but we think we can reach all those capabilities with a lower investment.
sentences.zh: 西班牙有一个问题，那就是西班牙表示，好吧，我们同意，但我们认为我们可以用更少的投资实现所有这些能力。

sentences.en: That is absolutely impossible.
sentences.zh: 那是绝对不可能的。

sentences.en: So history will prove them wrong, but that's an agreement to disagree.
sentences.zh: 所以历史会证明他们是错的，但这属于保留意见的分歧。

sentences.en: But then to your question, we have an enormous geopolitical challenge on our hands.
sentences.zh: 回到你的问题，我们面前有着巨大的地缘政治挑战。

sentences.en: And that is first of all, Russia, which is reconstituting itself at a pace and a speed, which is unparalleled in recent history.
sentences.zh: 首先就是俄罗斯，它正以近代史上前所未有的节奏和速度重整军备。

sentences.en: They are now producing three times as much ammunition in three months as the whole of NATO is doing in a year.
sentences.zh: 他们现在在三个月内生产的弹药量，是整个北约一年产量的三倍。

sentences.en: And don't forget, Russia is only the size of the economy of Texas, 2 trillion, and the whole of NATO is 50 trillion.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，俄罗斯的经济规模仅相当于得克萨斯州，即2万亿美元，而整个北约的经济规模是50万亿美元。

sentences.en: So this is unsustainable.
sentences.zh: 所以这是不可持续的。

sentences.en: But the Russians are working together with the North
sentences.zh: 但俄罗斯人正与朝鲜人

sentences.en: Koreans, with the Chinese and Iranians, the Mullahs in Ukraine, in fighting this war, unprovoked war of aggression against Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 、中国人和伊朗人、乌克兰战事中的毛拉们合作，共同进行这场对乌克兰的不义侵略战争。

sentences.en: So here in the Pacific, the Atlantic are getting more and more interconnected.
sentences.zh: 因此，印太地区和太平洋与大西洋正变得越来越紧密相连。

sentences.en: We know that China has its eye on Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 我们知道中国正对台湾虎视眈眈。

sentences.en: Given this whole geopolitical setup, there is no way we can defend ourselves if we would stick to this old
sentences.zh: 鉴于整个地缘政治格局，如果我们固守陈旧的
2%目标，我们就绝无可能保卫自己。

sentences.en: So when it comes to core defense spending, we have to move up to 3.5%.
sentences.zh: 所以在核心国防开支方面，我们必须提升到3.5%。

sentences.en: And then, of course, there is all the defense-related spending because a bridge needs to hold a tank if it crosses the bridge.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然还有所有与国防相关的开支，因为桥梁如果让坦克通过，它就必须能承受得住。

sentences.en: We need to develop the defense industrial base.
sentences.zh: 我们需要发展国防工业基础。

sentences.en: We need to spend money on cyber, on a hybrid.
sentences.zh: 我们需要把钱花在网络安全、混合战上。

sentences.en: We need to prepare our societies at large, so beyond the military.
sentences.zh: 我们需要让我们的整个社会做好准备，超越军事层面。

sentences.en: And that's the extra 1.5% leading into the 5%.
sentences.zh: 这就是通往5%的额外1.5%。

sentences.en: So yes, this is an enormous amount of spending, but if we don't, we have to learn Russian.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，这是一笔巨额开支，但如果我们不这么做，我们就得去学俄语了。

sentences.en: That's the short summary.
sentences.zh: 这就是简短的总结。

sentences.zh: 北约的理念之一是关于对民主价值观有共同承诺的盟友。

sentences.en: I mean, it was created for that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它是为此而建立的。

sentences.en: And now you have as part of this alliance what some would call a democratically backsliding United States.
sentences.zh: 现在，作为这个联盟的一部分，有些人称之为民主倒退的美国。

sentences.en: You have Hungary, which calls itself an illiberal democracy.
sentences.zh: 你有自称为非自由民主国家的匈牙利。

sentences.en: And you have Turkey under President Erdogan, which has been called an electoral autocracy.
sentences.zh: 还有在埃尔多安总统领导下的土耳其，被称为选举独裁政权。

sentences.en: I mean, can this alliance hold when the very values at its heart are no longer commonly held in the way that perhaps they once had been.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当联盟核心的价值观不再像过去那样被普遍认同时，这个联盟还能维持下去吗？

sentences.en: Well, I'm not sure I would completely subscribe to all the assumptions in your question, but that is the debate as democracies we can have.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不敢说我完全同意你问题中的所有假设，但作为民主国家，我们可以进行这样的辩论。

sentences.en: That is why we are indeed an alliance of democracies.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们确实是一个民主国家联盟。

sentences.en: And I can tell you that in NATO, you will have many debates and issues between countries.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，在北约，国家之间会有很多辩论和问题。

sentences.en: There are debates on values and everything.
sentences.zh: 关于价值观和其他一切都有辩论。

sentences.en: That's exactly why this alliance is so alive and so strong, because we sometimes have these tough issues.
sentences.zh: 这正是这个联盟如此充满活力和强大原因所在，因为我们有时会遇到这些棘手的问题。

sentences.en: We fight them out, and then we come together and agree.
sentences.zh: 我们通过抗争解决它们，然后聚在一起达成一致。

sentences.en: And at this moment, I can only tell you that this alliance of 32 countries is stronger and more united than ever in recent history.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，我只能告诉你，这由 32 个国家组成的联盟比近代史上的任何时候都更加强大、更加团结。

sentences.en: And America plays a big role here in the new administration, but also, of course, the threat from the Russians.
sentences.zh: 美国在新政府中发挥了很大作用，当然还有来自俄罗斯的威胁。

sentences.en: But you have a different relationship.
sentences.zh: 但你们的关系不同。

sentences.en: But I cannot in my role debate the pluses and minuses of what is happening in each of the 32 allies.
sentences.zh: 但在我的角色中，我不能辩论 32 个盟友中每个国家正在发生的事情的利弊。

sentences.en: I will never do that because my role is and job is to make sure the alliance stays together as strong as possible.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会那样做，因为我的角色和工作是确保联盟尽可能强大地团结在一起。

sentences.en: Right, but Viktor Orban's close relationship with Putin is very well documented.
sentences.zh: 没错，但欧尔班与普京的密切关系是有据可查的。

sentences.en: So it's not just about debates and competing viewpoints.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是关于辩论和竞争观点的问题。

sentences.en: This is about the very soul of the alliance and what it's meant to do.
sentences.zh: 这是关于联盟的灵魂以及它的初衷。

sentences.en: I understand.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: And that means that sometimes internally without the press there, and that is not very democratic, but that's the only way to do it,
sentences.zh: 这意味着有时在内部没有媒体在场的情况下——这不是很民主，但这是唯一的办法——

sentences.en: that sometimes internally and in a discreet way, you have your discussions and your debates, but never out in the open.
sentences.zh: 有时在内部以谨慎的方式进行讨论和辩论，但绝不在公开场合进行。

sentences.en: That's impossible.
sentences.zh: 这是不可能的。

sentences.en: And by the way, what you said about the U.S.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，你关于美国的说法

sentences.en: and backsliding, I would not agree with this.
sentences.zh: 和倒退，我不同意这一点。

sentences.en: I think the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我认为美国

sentences.en: is still one of the strongest democracies on earth.
sentences.zh: 依然是世界上最强大的民主国家之一。

sentences.en: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth recently refused to rule out military intervention in Greenland, possibly a takeover.
sentences.zh: 国防部长皮特·海格塞斯最近拒绝排除对格陵兰岛进行军事干预的可能性，甚至可能是接管。

sentences.en: I mean, you've said before directly to President Trump that you don't want to drag NATO into this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你以前曾直接对特朗普总统说过，你不想把北约卷入其中。

sentences.en: But Greenland is governed by Denmark, a member of NATO.
sentences.zh: 但格陵兰岛由北约成员国丹麦管辖。

sentences.en: So what do you do when one NATO country is talking about attacking the territory of another or taking over the territory of another?
sentences.zh: 那么，当一个北约国家谈论攻击另一个国家的领土或接管另一个国家的领土时，你该怎么办？

sentences.en: Sorry for the boring answer again, but when it comes to these issues between NATO allies, I can never comment about them in public.
sentences.zh: 抱歉又是这个无聊的回答，但当谈到北约盟友之间的这些问题时，我永远不能在公开场合对此发表评论。

sentences.en: That has not been done for 76 years.
sentences.zh: 76年来一直如此。

sentences.en: No, the Secretary General is only there since 74 years.
sentences.zh: 不，秘书长只在那里呆了 74 年。

sentences.en: NATO is there for 76 years.
sentences.zh: 北约已经存在 76 年了。

sentences.en: It's this overarching question about what is the alliance really about?
sentences.zh: 这是一个总括性的问题，即联盟的真正意义是什么？

sentences.en: If these 32 members are still united by a common vision of what it's supposed to achieve.
sentences.zh: 如果这 32 个成员国仍然通过对它应该实现的目标的共同愿景团结在一起。

sentences.en: And they are.
sentences.zh: 他们确实如此。

sentences.en: And we are.
sentences.zh: 我们也是。

sentences.en: So it doesn't concern you that Trump has also talked about Annex in Canada, for example, also a NATO member.
sentences.zh: 所以你难道不担心特朗普也曾谈到过吞并加拿大，例如，这也是一个北约成员国。

sentences.en: When I'm not commenting about discussions between individual allies, of course, I will not comment on that.
sentences.zh: 当我不对各个盟友之间的讨论发表评论时，我当然也不会对此发表评论。

sentences.en: No, I can't.
sentences.zh: 不，我不能。

sentences.en: That's not my role.
sentences.zh: 这不是我的职责。

sentences.en: Just a step back.
sentences.zh: 退一步讲。

sentences.en: I think a lot of what is being discussed around NATO in the United States and really in Europe, from what I've heard, is uncertainty around America's role in the alliance.
sentences.zh: 我认为围绕北约在美国乃至整个欧洲讨论的很多内容，据我所听到的，是对美国在联盟中角色的不确定性。

sentences.en: And the reason there's this uncertainty is because of the things that we've discussed.
sentences.zh: 存在这种不确定性的原因正是因为我们所讨论的事情。

sentences.en: You know, Trump's America is mercurial on its international obligations.
sentences.zh: 你知道，特朗普的美国对其国际义务变化无常。

sentences.en: Things like the Greenland and Canada issues make people worry about America's expansionist ambitions, possibly.
sentences.zh: 诸如格陵兰岛和加拿大之类的问题让人们担心美国的扩张主义野心。

sentences.en: and so as an alliance that so relies on the intelligence the manpower the weapons the logistics the nuclear umbrella can there be a nato without the u.s if it ever came to that
sentences.zh: 因此作为一个如此依赖情报、人力、武器、后勤、核保护伞的联盟，如果没有美国，还会有北约吗？如果真有那么一天的话

sentences.en: but it won't come to that it won't and let me give you another picture so this is one picture
sentences.zh: 但不会走到那一步的，不会的，让我给你展现另一幅画面，这是其中一幅画面

sentences.en: let me give you another one eight countries are two percent this year would never have happened without Trump.
sentences.zh: 让我给你看另一幅画面，八个国家今年达到百分之二，如果没有特朗普，这绝对不会发生。

sentences.en: The whole of NATO committing to this 5% would not have happened without
sentences.zh: 整个北约承诺达到这 5% 的目标，如果没有

sentences.en: President Trump there.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在那儿。

sentences.en: I mean, all these things have been, are there because of President Trump and his team.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，所有这些事情之所以存在，都是因为特朗普总统和他的团队。

sentences.en: So this is also a way to look at it.
sentences.zh: 所以这也是一种看待问题的方式。

sentences.en: So I think this is very much in foreign relations, foreign policy, investing American president, understanding the power the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这在外交关系、外交政策中非常重要，投资美国总统，理解美国拥有的权力。

sentences.en: has.
sentences.zh: 权力。

sentences.en: Of course, his style can be a bit harsh.
sentences.zh: 当然，他的风格可能有点严厉。

sentences.en: Yes, but without that style and him being sometimes harsh,
sentences.zh: 是的，但如果没有这种风格以及他有时表现出的严厉，

sentences.en: I'm not sure that we would have the outcome at the NATO summit last week we had.
sentences.zh: 我不确定我们能否取得上周北约峰会上那样的结果。

sentences.en: Listening to you talk, I am hearing you articulate the feeling that you clearly strongly have that
sentences.zh: 听着你说话，我听到你表达了你显然非常强烈的感受

sentences.en: Trump is handling America's role in the world very well and that you don't have any concerns about his relationship with NATO.
sentences.zh: 特朗普把美国在世界上的角色处理得非常好，而且你对他的北约关系没有任何担忧。

sentences.en: What do you think the president's critics don't understand about him and the way he views America's role in the world?
sentences.zh: 你认为总统的批评者对他在处理美国在世界上的角色这一问题上有何误解？

sentences.en: You know, I'm a transatlanticiSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我是个坚定的跨大西洋主义者。

sentences.en: I was born in a family which felt deeply indebted to the United States, together with Canada and Poland, liberating my part of Europe, the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 我出生在一个对美国、加拿大和波兰充满感恩的家庭，正是它们解放了我的欧洲故乡——荷兰。

sentences.en: And I've always been raised with the absolute realization that without a transatlantic relationship, which keeps the US strong, which keeps Europe strong,
sentences.zh: 我从小就深刻地意识到，如果没有跨大西洋关系来保持美国的强大、保持欧洲的强大，

sentences.en: we might have been communist in this part of Europe at this moment and part of the Soviet Union instead of a part of the free world.
sentences.zh: 我们欧洲的这部分现在可能已经成了共产主义地区，成了苏联的一部分，而不是自由世界的一部分。

sentences.en: And President Trump, in my view, is totally committed to that tradition.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，特朗普总统完全致力于这一传统。

sentences.en: Very irritated indeed about the somewhat free rider thing here in Europe.
sentences.zh: 他确实对欧洲这里的某种搭便车现象感到非常恼火。

sentences.en: And that has now been corrected.
sentences.zh: 而现在这种情况已经得到了纠正。

sentences.en: And I find it a bit unfair that we are constantly questioning the US, are you still with us?
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们不断质问美国“你们还和我们在一起吗？”这有点不公平。

sentences.en: And if you are still with us, are you really with us?
sentences.zh: “如果你们还和我们在一起，你们是真心在一起吗？”

sentences.en: Or might you maybe leave us one day?
sentences.zh: “还是说你们哪天可能会离开我们？”

sentences.en: To be fair, that's based on the president's own statements.
sentences.zh: 平心而论，那也是基于总统自己的言论。

sentences.en: This is not supposition, but please go on.
sentences.zh: 这不是推测，但请继续。

sentences.en: Yeah, but when you, for example, what he said about Article 5, Article 5 is ambiguous in itself
sentences.zh: 是的，但是当你说起……例如他关于第五条的言论，第五条本身就是模棱两可的，

sentences.en: because we will never want to make Putin or Xi Jinping or whoever might ever try something against us wiser than he or she is at the moment.
sentences.zh: 因为我们永远不想让普京、习近平或任何可能对我们图谋不轨的人，变得比他或她目前实际了解得更多。

sentences.en: And look at this closing press conference in The Hague.
sentences.zh: 看看在海牙的那场闭幕新闻发布会。

sentences.en: I mean, it couldn't be clearer than this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，再清楚不过了。

sentences.en: Put on the television when President Macron was visiting the White House, when Prime Minister Starmer was visiting the White House,
sentences.zh: 回想马克龙总统访问白宫时、斯塔默首相访问白宫时，

sentences.en: when Prime Minister Maloney was visiting the White House.
sentences.zh: 梅洛尼首相访问白宫时。

sentences.en: Listen to President Trump's comments.
sentences.zh: 听听特朗普总统的评论。

sentences.en: You cannot have a clearer commitment to NATO than what he said on those occasions.
sentences.zh: 对于北约的承诺，不可能比他在那些场合说的话更清晰了。

sentences.en: So you think NATO will last another 50 years with America at its heart?
sentences.zh: 所以你认为以美国为核心的北约还能再维持50年？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: I have no doubt.
sentences.zh: 我毫无疑问。

sentences.en: America being the leader in the world and also within NATO, but it's the Europeans taking their fair share in terms of the burden.
sentences.zh: 美国是世界以及北约内部的领导者，但欧洲人也要在分摊责任方面承担起他们应尽的份额。

sentences.en: And that's only good, and that makes that NATO is stronger and fairer and more lethal, exactly as we should be.
sentences.zh: 而这绝对是好事，它使北约更强大、更公正、更具威慑力，正如我们本该做的那样。
